articles.title: Binance says its European regulatory application is compliant despite report of Greek rejection
articles.snippet: An EU crypto license application by the world’s largest crypto exchange is set to be rejected by the Greek regulator HCMC, according to a report from Reuters.

articles.title: State Street targets stablecoin reserve boom with new money market fund
articles.snippet: The asset manager joins BlackRock, Franklin Templeton and others competing to manage reserves backing the growing stablecoin market.

articles.title: State Street launches GENIUS Act-aligned money market fund for stablecoin reserves
articles.snippet: The launch comes amid growing competition among financial institutions to manage assets backing dollar-pegged stablecoins.

articles.title: Binance says it considers EU license compliant amid reports of potential rejection
articles.snippet: Without specifically calling out a report on Binance’s EU license, the crypto exchange warned that any rejection forcing it to delay activities in the region could “weaken liquidity” and present other potential risks.

articles.title: Why a ‘safe’ AI can turn dangerous in the wrong company
articles.snippet: A 15-day AI agent simulation shows why short tests may miss long-term risks shaped by tools, rules and other agents.
